challenge_facts_addressed.effect_on_judgment: Two Alex-initiated one-on-one plans provide meaningful support for special interest, though C1-F4 shows that Alex also makes one-on-one plans with other friends.

Remembering the presentation, sending encouragement, and bringing Jordan's preferred tea demonstrate personalized attention and modestly strengthen A, but Alex also checks in on and brings treats for others under C1-F4.
Four extended post-event text conversations show sustained individual engagement and are the strongest evidence favoring A, but they do not establish romantic intent.

reason_for_retaining_or_changing: B remains somewhat better supported because C1-F4 provides a direct general-friendliness baseline, C1-F5 contains no explicit romantic signal across ten weeks, and C1-F6 shows limited follow-through on Jordan's proposed dinner. C1-F1 through C1-F3 make the case closer, but do not outweigh those facts.

revised_recommended_action.explanation: The evidence remains mixed but leans toward general friendliness; observing whether Alex independently renews or prioritizes one-on-one plans may provide clearer evidence.
